entries.question: Which issues does the mission close and what is out of scope?

entries.final_answer: in_review: claim conflict naming the reviewer. approved: refuse, pointing at move-task --to planned --review-feedback-file. for_review: only the implementer of record may withdraw it back to in_progress. No fabricated rejection reason anywhere.
entries.question: What should agent action implement do for a WP in for_review, in_review and approved?

entries.final_answer: agent action implement --force --note <text>: --note is required with --force and is threaded into the event reason; the actor is recorded.
